_doc: Full-size config for non-smoke runs. The smoke harness reads SMOKE_DEFAULTS in smoke_eval.py; this is reference for orchestrators that want a stronger run. The smoke config is a scaled-down version of this file (hidden 64 -> 32) — same architecture shape (modes, blocks).
_loss_weight_doc: Per-fidelity loss weighting (MFRNP Poisson5_config.yaml). poisson_hf_weight multiplies the m=1 (HF) loss; poisson_lf_weight multiplies the m<1 (LF) losses. Applied ONLY when dataset_name contains 'poisson'; Heat uses uniform weights (1.0, 1.0) per published pde_config.yaml.
